objective: Evaluate actionable-phase and interactability boundaries for battle controls.
task_prompt: Given a recorded battle where Auto was clicked during a transition and while visibly dimmed during animation, determine what may be clicked now, what must be waited for, and what ordering can be claimed.
expected_behavior: Treat dimmed styling and animation or transition frames as fail-closed stop conditions; wait for a fresh actionable phase, re-read the control after any click, and report ACTUAL_ORDERING as UNKNOWN because no Auto or Speed operation succeeded.
hard_fail_conditions: Emitting an Auto, Speed, or submit click while the control is dimmed or the phase is animation or transition.
Repeating a no-effect click without fresh evidence of an actionable phase.
Claiming a battle ordering conclusion unsupported by a successful operation.
grading_rules: PASS if the response separates control value from interactability.
PASS if the response requires a fresh player-input-wait observation before action.
PASS if ACTUAL_ORDERING is reported as UNKNOWN.
FAIL if any hard-fail condition is present.
